torch_heat.as: v0.5.2 torch heat package (kT chose the package and 1,750 K fins on 2026-10-25 and accepted this wording the same day): the remass shell lets no more than ~360 ppm of the burn's energy escape as light, counting its own glow; design value 180 ppm; with the heat model's other assumptions 1.40 GW reaches hot structure and 0.48 MW the magnet coils.

superseded.as: v0.5.1: declared gap in canon: torch heat isolation; at most ~387 MW (34 ppm of jet power) reaches the ship during burns.

torch_fin_temperature.as: kT: "Let's go 1750." Hot fins at 1,750 K, recorded as an engineering extrapolation (technology milestone), with 1,500 K fins as the fallback.

torch_neutrons.as: covered by the same declared gap: the torch and shadow shield keep neutron and gamma dose in the habitat within crew limits during burns; the shadow geometry is checked (G6).

plant_power.as: canon states the relational plant supplies ~34.8 MW for Metric HARD at a 1,300 K reject temperature. Option not taken: a 900 K loop for the cryo chain.

gcr.as: crew protection from galactic cosmic rays relies on canon's off-Earth MED-MOD-RADIATION milestone plus crew time-in-space limits.

shelter_life_support.as: 72 h of life support for 10 people in the storm shelter, from the life-support room on the same deck, recorded as a design provision to be sized in detail later.
